rulebook.title: World Aquatics Swimming Rules (SW), Facilities Rules (FR) and General Rules (GR)
rulebook.text_used: written from general knowledge of the World Aquatics (formerly FINA) rules; the site was not reachable from this session, so the wording and rule numbers were not re-checked against the current edition.

pool_m.note: Olympic Games and World Championships; lanes 0 and 9 are empty buffer lanes when 8 swimmers race

starting_platform.note: an adjustable back plate (kick plate) is allowed

scene.text: 50 m pool, lanes 2.5 m wide separated by lane ropes, dark lane lines and end-wall targets on the pool floor; backstroke flags across the pool 5 m from each wall.

Swimwear of textile only: men's suits reach no higher than the navel and no lower than the knee; women's suits leave the neck and shoulders uncovered and reach no lower than the knee. Up to two caps and goggles are allowed.
Referee and starter at the end of the pool, stroke judges walking the sides, turn judges at each end of every lane.

fouls.title: One foot at the front of the block
fouls.text: On 'take your marks' the swimmers immediately take a starting position with at least one foot at the front of the starting platform; the position of the hands does not matter.
fouls.legal: the front foot's toes are at the front edge of the block
avoid: both feet at the back of the starting block

fouls.title: False start
fouls.text: Any swimmer who starts before the starting signal is disqualified; everyone is still in the set position until the signal.
avoid: swimmer already diving while the others are still set

fouls.title: Freestyle: part of the swimmer breaks the surface
fouls.text: Some part of the swimmer must break the surface throughout the race, except during the turn and for up to 15 m after the start and each turn.
fouls.legal: the head, back or recovering arm breaks the surface

fouls.title: Butterfly: arms forward together over the water
fouls.text: Both arms are brought forward together over the water and backward together under the water throughout the race.
fouls.legal: both hands are over the water, side by side
avoid: one arm forward and the other back

fouls.title: Butterfly: legs move together
fouls.text: All up and down movements of the legs are simultaneous; the legs need not be level but may not alternate, and a breaststroke kick is not allowed.

fouls.title: Breaststroke: elbows under the water
fouls.text: The hands are pushed forward together from the breast on, under or over the water; the elbows stay under the water except for the last stroke before a turn, during the turn and at the finish; the hands are not brought back beyond the hip line except in the first stroke after the start and each turn.
fouls.legal: both elbows are under the surface
avoid: breaststroke swimmer lifting the elbows out of the water

fouls.title: Breaststroke: arms and legs together, in one horizontal plane
fouls.text: All movements of the arms, and of the legs, are simultaneous and in the same horizontal plane without alternating; the feet are turned out in the propulsive part of the kick; scissor, flutter and downward butterfly kicks are not allowed (except one butterfly kick in the first pull-out).
fouls.legal: left and right mirror each other
avoid: one hand ahead of the other

fouls.title: Breaststroke: head breaks the surface every cycle
fouls.text: During each complete cycle of one arm stroke and one leg kick, some part of the head breaks the surface.
fouls.legal: the head is up out of the water for the breath
